notes: Invite friends to your world: in a singleplayer world, press Escape and click Invite Friends, then Get Invite Code. The code is copied for you, and there is an invite link in chat.
Your friend enters the code in Multiplayer > Join with Code, or just opens the link. They join your world - and the mods you have on (guns, horror mods and the rest) are turned on for them too.
The Cave Dweller now comes up in the caves you are in, not in a pocket above or below you.
